title: nitpicker.config.json
description: Configuration of nitpicker, a quality gate for code written by coding agents. Generated from the definitions the validator reads (npm run gen:schema).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editor completion and checks. nitpicker ignores it.

base.description: The base ref used when neither --base nor a CI target branch is given. Never HEAD or the commit you are on.

preset.description: The preset; typescript when absent. Java, Kotlin, Python and Go are never detected.

disable.description: Analyzer names to turn off, without duplicates. Turning one off also turns off the analyzers that depend on it.

thresholds.description: Size and time limits, replacing the preset defaults. A raised limit is a policy loosening.

crapLimit.description: A function whose CRAP score is at or above this fails (default 9).

folderFiles.description: Source files, and separately test files, directly in one folder (default 6).

folderDepth.description: Folders below the feature layer (TypeScript, JavaScript; default 1) or packages below the root package (default 4 for Java and Kotlin, 4 for Python).

classMethods.description: Methods per class (Java, Kotlin, Python; default 20).

classFields.description: Instance fields per class (Java, Kotlin, Python; default 10).

inheritanceDepth.description: Superclasses per class (Java, Kotlin, Python; default 3).

unitTestSeconds.description: Seconds one unit test the change adds or edits may take (default 5).

integrationTestSeconds.description: Seconds one integration test the change adds or edits may take (default 30).

exclude.description: Globs, relative to the project root, of files every analyzer skips. Excluding code is a policy loosening.

layout.description: Where the code lives. The TypeScript and JavaScript presets take every key.

sourceRoots.description: Directories with the production code (TypeScript, JavaScript; default ["src"]).

testRoots.description: Directories with the tests (TypeScript, JavaScript; default ["test","tests","__tests__","e2e"]).

excludedGlobs.description: Globs that replace the built-in exclusions (TypeScript, JavaScript).

entryPoints.description: Globs of files that are started or loaded by path and so are never imported (TypeScript, JavaScript).

sharedRoots.description: Folder globs of shared code: a module there that only one feature uses is reported.

featureRoots.description: Folder globs whose direct subfolders are one feature each; [] turns the rule off.

exceptions.description: Rules lifted for some paths. Each finding prints the entry that lifts it.

react.description: The React rule scope (TypeScript preset only).

enabled.description: true or false forces the React rules on or off; without it nitpicker decides from the project's dependencies.

styling.description: The one styling approach the project uses; inferred from the sources when unset.

i18n.description: The i18n rule scope for react-intl (TypeScript preset only).

enabled.description: true or false forces the i18n rules on or off; without it nitpicker decides from the project's dependencies.

functionNames.description: Wrappers of formatMessage that are checked too.

componentNames.description: Wrappers of FormattedMessage that are checked too.

analyzers.description: Custom analyzers: commands that print a findings report.

name.description: The analyzer name, shown in reports.

command.description: The command to run, relative to the project root.

legacyInventory.description: Path of the legacy inventory inside the project; nitpicker.legacy.json when absent.

skippedFolders.description: Folder names (no slashes, commas, glob characters or leading "!") the scan skips at any depth. Replaces the built-in list.

python.description: Overrides for what nitpicker detects in a Python project (python preset only).

environment.description: The tool that manages the environment, or the directory of a virtual environment.

importLinter.description: false turns the import-linter check off.

entryPoints.description: Files that are started or loaded by path and so are never imported.

exceptions.description: Exceptions for the Python rules that the top-level "exceptions" does not take.

tools.description: Which config each tool uses, and its engine or runner.

precedence.description: Which config prettier uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once, highest first.
Which config jscpd uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once, highest first.
Which config knip uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once, highest first.
Which config dependency-cruiser uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once, highest first.

engine.description: "oxlint" runs the lint rules on oxlint (the default); "eslint" runs them on ESLint

precedence.description: Which config eslint uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once, highest first.

engine.description: "native" type checks with TypeScript 7 (the default); "project" uses the project's own TypeScript

project.description: The TypeScript config file of the project the type check reads.

runner.description: It names the runner that runs the project's tests; without it nitpicker uses the runner the project's test script, config files or dependencies name

timeouts.description: Timeout tiers for the tests of the project.

testTimeoutMs.description: The timeout of one test, in milliseconds.

hookTimeoutMs.description: The timeout of one setup or teardown hook, in milliseconds.

testDeclarationCeilingMs.description: The longest timeout a test may declare for itself, in milliseconds.

hookDeclarationCeilingMs.description: The longest timeout a hook may declare for itself, in milliseconds.

precedence.description: Which config pmd uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once.
Which config checkstyle uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once.

Which config ktlint uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once. "project" must come first: ktlint reads the project's .editorconfig natively, which always wins over nitpicker's measured conventions.

Which config ktfmt uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once. "project" must come first: ktfmt reads the project's .editorconfig natively, which always wins over nitpicker's measured conventions.
Which config detekt uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once.
Which config ruff uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once.

Which config black uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once. "project" must come first: black has no flag that switches string normalization back on, so nitpicker's quote style cannot win over the project's skip-string-normalization.
Which config pyright uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once.
Which config mypy uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once.
Which config mutmut uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once.
Which config coverage uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once.
Which config gofumpt uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once.
Which config goimports uses: "project" is your own config file, "nitpicker" is the preset's. List each at most once.

testConsole.description: The allowlist of the test console output check.

contains.description: A fragment of the printed message. At least three characters must remain once numbers become <n> and ids become <id>.

paths.description: Test file globs that limit the entry; at least one.

reason.description: Which library prints this and why it is acceptable.

formatter.description: The format check to run; detected when absent.

detektConfig.description: Path of the detekt config inside the project; detected when absent.

roles.description: Annotation or type names, by role, whose classes count in that role for the Spring architecture rules, on top of Spring stereotypes. Removing a name loosens the policy.

controller.description: Binary names of annotations or types whose classes are a controller, such as "com.example.UseCase".

service.description: Binary names of annotations or types whose classes are a service, such as "com.example.UseCase".

repository.description: Binary names of annotations or types whose classes are a repository, such as "com.example.UseCase".

conventions.description: Pins a style that nitpicker otherwise measures from the project.

formatters.description: The format checks to run; detected from go.mod and the golangci-lint config when absent.

buildTags.description: Build tags passed as -tags to go vet and go test, such as "integration".

history.description: Opt-in analysis of the commit history (every preset).

coChange.description: true turns on the change-history analyzer, which reports modules that keep changing together.

commits.description: How many recent commits to read (default 300). Needs "coChange".

minSupport.description: The commits two modules must share (default 5). Needs "coChange".

minConfidence.description: The share of the less-changed module's commits that must include the other (default 0.6). Needs "coChange".

maxCommitFiles.description: The most files a commit may touch and still count (default 30). Needs "coChange".

prettier.printWidth.description: Line width: "80" (80 columns), "100" (100 columns), "120" (120 columns), or a whole number from 10 to 999.

prettier.trailingCommas.description: Trailing commas: "all" (everywhere), "es5" (not after the last argument), "none" (none).

typescript.assertionHelpers.description: Assertion helpers: the names of the helper functions that count as assertions.

prettier.bracketSameLine.description: JSX closing bracket: "newLine" (on its own line), "sameLine" (after the last attribute).

typescript.typeImports.description: Type-only imports: "separate" (import type { A }), "inline" (import { type A }).

prettier.printWidth.description: Line width: "80" (80 columns), "100" (100 columns), "120" (120 columns), or a whole number from 10 to 999.

prettier.trailingCommas.description: Trailing commas: "all" (everywhere), "es5" (not after the last argument), "none" (none).

typescript.assertionHelpers.description: Assertion helpers: the names of the helper functions that count as assertions.

java.lineLength.description: Java line length: "100" (100 columns), "120" (120 columns), "140" (140 columns), or a whole number from 10 to 999.

java.testStaticImports.description: Java static imports in tests: "explicit" (explicit only), "wildcard" (wildcards allowed).

java.assertionHelpers.description: Java assertion helpers: the names of the helper functions that count as assertions.

java.lineLength.description: Java line length: "100" (100 columns), "120" (120 columns), "140" (140 columns), or a whole number from 10 to 999.

java.testStaticImports.description: Java static imports in tests: "explicit" (explicit only), "wildcard" (wildcards allowed).

java.assertionHelpers.description: Java assertion helpers: the names of the helper functions that count as assertions.

kotlin.trailingCommas.description: Kotlin trailing commas: "always" (required in wrapped lists), "never" (not used).

kotlin.lineLength.description: Kotlin line length: "100" (100 columns), "120" (120 columns), "140" (140 columns), or a whole number from 10 to 999.

kotlin.assertionHelpers.description: Kotlin assertion helpers: the names of the helper functions that count as assertions.

python.lineLength.description: Python line length: "79" (79 columns), "88" (88 columns), "100" (100 columns), "120" (120 columns), or a whole number from 10 to 999.

exception.description: One rule lifted for some paths.

rule.description: The rule to lift, as a finding prints it: a nitpicker rule such as "file-lines-limit", an ESLint, ruff or other tool rule, or "<tool>/<rule>" (for example "pmd/UnusedPrivateField"). The message of each finding prints the whole entry to copy.

paths.description: Globs, relative to the project root with "/" separators, of the files (or folders, for folder rules) the rule is lifted for.

packages.description: Package names the unused-dependency, unlisted-dependency or unresolved-import rule is lifted for.

function.description: The name of the one function the rule is lifted for. Only for the function and coverage rules; required for changed-branch-coverage.

name.description: The name of the one declaration the rule is lifted for. Only for the dead-code rules "exports" and "types".

reason.description: Why the rule is lifted here. Required, and it must say something: the "..." a message prints is refused.
